newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek signs 5-yr $210 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Partek signs 5-yr $210 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Finnish building materials and cargo handling equipment group Partek Oy Ab said on Monday it had signed a $210 million five-year syndicated credit facility arranged by U.S. Citibank and Finnish Merita.
"Partek ... has today signed a 210 million dollar syndicated multi-currency revolving credit facility. The maturity of the facility is five years," Partek said in a statement.
The facility would be used to replace other credit lines and refinance existing loans of its recently acquired engineering subsidiary Sisu Oy, it said.
The other banks participating in the syndication are ABN-Amro Bank, Den Danske Bank, Finnish Export Credit, Kredietbank and Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken.
Partek did not give any information about the loans's interest rate or repayment structure.
